meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会分析你对 NanoClaw 项目的自定义改动，整理成一份可重放的迁移指南；升级时会在干净的上游版本上按指南重新应用这些改动，而不是直接合并代码。
howto.when: 当你说“迁移 Nanoclaw”“升级到上游”等关键词，或要求保留自定义设置进行更新时触发。

say.text: 把 Nanoclaw 的改动整理成迁移指南。
升级到最新上游，同时保留我的所有自定义。
say.note: Claude 会先检查工作区再走迁移流程。

say.text: 我的定制分散在多个文件，帮我找出并记录。
say.note: Claude 会用子代理探查代码变更。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your custom changes to the NanoClaw project and compiles them into a replayable migration guide. On upgrade, it reapplies changes from the guide on a clean upstream base instead of merging code directly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say “migrate Nanoclaw”, “upgrade to upstream”, or similar keywords, or when you ask to keep customizations during an update.

say_en.text: Turn my NanoClaw customizations into a migration guide.
say_en.note: Claude will start extracting and analyzing.

say_en.text: Upgrade to the latest upstream while keeping all my customizations.
say_en.note: Claude will check the working tree first, then run the migration.

say_en.text: My customizations are scattered across files—find and document them.
say_en.note: Claude will use sub-agents to inspect code changes.
